note.summary:
1.2 Healthy living and lifestyle
Key focus
- diet, exercise, wellbeing, habits and giving advice.

Core language
- Useful structures: मेरे विचार में; मुझे ... पसंद है क्योंकि; पिछले साल; अगली बार; आम तौर पर; मुझे ... चाहिए।
- Use time frequency phrases, modal expressions for advice, and connect opinions with clear reasons.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: मैं हफ़्ते में दो बार तैराकी करता हूँ क्योंकि इससे मुझे आराम मिलता है।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

I swim twice a week because it helps me relax.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: सुबह नाश्ते में मैं फल, दही और एक गिलास पानी लेता हूँ।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

For breakfast I have fruit, yoghurt and a glass of water.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: जब मैं छोटा था, तो बहुत मिठाई खाता था और खेल नहीं खेलता था।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

When I was little, I ate lots of sweets and did not play sport.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: स्कूल के बाद मैं बस लेने के बजाय पैदल घर जाता हूँ।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

After school I walk home instead of taking the bus.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: कल मैं बहुत थका हुआ था क्योंकि रात को कम नींद आई थी।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

Yesterday I was very tired because I had slept little at night.

questions.examTip: Use correct word order, postpositions (को, में, से, का/की/के) and verb agreement; place the main verb at the end.
questions.modelAnswer: आगे मैं चिप्स कम खाऊँगा और रोज़ाना आठ घंटे सोना चाहूँगा।
questions.question:
Translate into Hindi:

In future I will eat fewer crisps and would like to sleep eight hours daily.

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use past and future forms where relevant, and justify opinions with क्योंकि.
questions.modelAnswer:
मैं हफ़्ते में दो बार तैराकी करता हूँ क्योंकि इससे मुझे आराम मिलता है। सुबह नाश्ते में मैं फल, दही और एक गिलास पानी लेता हूँ। जब मैं छोटा था, तो बहुत मिठाई खाता था और खेल नहीं खेलता था। मेरे विचार में यह महत्वपूर्ण है और भविष्य में मैं एक नया अनुभव लेना चाहूँगा।

(English translation: I swim twice a week because it helps me relax. For breakfast I have fruit, yoghurt and a glass of water. When I was little, I ate lots of sweets and did not play sport. In my opinion it is important, and in the future I would like to have a new experience.)
